summary: Tested NEW HR modules (Dashboard, Reminder Kontrak, Cuti & Izin, Absensi rekap, Penilaian Kinerja, Struktur Organisasi, Pengumuman, Riwayat Karir) + sidebar UI overhaul. Backend pytest 18/18 pass on new /api/hrd/dashboard, /leaves, /attendance, /reviews, /announcements, /career endpoints. Access-control (401 unauth, susanto=200) verified. Frontend Playwright end-to-end pass on all 8 requested flows for user 'heri' (sidebar w/ 8 items, dashboard stat-cards + bar/pie charts + widgets; Cuti create-list-saldo-delete w/ auto-hari=3; Absensi upsert + persistence; Kinerja skor entry+rata+delete; Organisasi dept grouping; Pengumuman create with PENTING badge and dashboard banner; Riwayat Karir add/delete in person-detail-dialog). Regression 'herliana Gaji PIN 123456' PASSED — sidebar Gaji card present, PIN dialog opens, PIN 123456 unlocks Gaji area and slip list loads. Skor > 5 clamped to 5 verified. Attendance upsert (no duplicate) verified. Announcements viewable by super (susanto).
critical_code_review_comments: hrd_extras.py list_leaves uses `tanggal_mulai: {$regex: ^{year}}` — works because dates stored as ISO strings, but a proper index on this field would be $gte/$lt range and is more efficient at scale.

attendance upsert filter does not include NOT_DELETED_FILTER; a previously soft-deleted attendance row with same (employee_id, year, month) would be silently re-hydrated by $set instead of a new record — low probability edge case but worth aligning with other collections.

reviews `rata` calculation ignores zero-scored criteria (only averages `filled = v for v in skor.values() if v`) — if a user genuinely enters 0 as a bad score it's treated as 'not filled'. UI already enforces min=1 so acceptable, but doc it or drop the filter.
announcements GET uses require_hrd (any hrd user incl. gaji-only), while POST/PUT/DELETE require hrd_dokumen — consistent with product intent (read wide, write narrow).

HrdDashboard.jsx fetches /announcements even if user has no hrd_dokumen perm; endpoint permits it (require_hrd) so no error, but for a purely gaji-only user this would show announcements they may not manage — feature not a bug.
test_credentials: heri/123456, herliana/123456, susanto/Subbalo1994 — all validated. Gaji PIN 123456 preserved (regression PASSED).

PIN 123456 unchanged. iteration_7's PersonDialog null-guard fix preserved.
